SELECT
 DAH.FORACID	AS	AccountID
,DAH.ORGKEY	AS	CustomerID
,NULL	AS	EntityCIF
,DAH.ORGKEY	AS	FCBSCIF
,DAH.AAS_BANK_ID	AS	BankCode
,DAH.DF_SOL_ID	AS	BranchCode
,DAH.BRANCH_NAME	AS	BranchName
,DAH.AREA	AS	Area
,DAH.REGION	AS	Region
,DAH.AAS_SOURCE_CODE	AS	Source
,DAH.PRODUCT_GROUP_DID	AS	ProductGrouping
,CONCAT(DAH.PRODUCT_GROUP_DID,'-',PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION)	AS	ProductDetails
,PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION	AS	ProductType
,DAH.ACCT_OPN_DATE	AS	OpenedDate
,CASE WHEN DAH.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END	AS	ShareIndicator 
,NULL	AS	MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,NULL	AS	MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
,DAH.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP	AS	YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,NULL	AS	YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
,DAH.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	AS	OutstandingBalance_Full
,NULL	AS	OutstandingBalance_Prorated
,CTL.CRM_DATE	AS	BusinessDate
,CTL.CRM_DATE	AS	LastUpdatedDate
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DAH.FORACID, DAH.ORGKEY, DAH.AAS_BANK_ID ORDER BY DAH.FORACID)	AS	AccountKey 
FROM eds.EDS_CTL CTL
    INNER JOIN eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER DAH
        ON CTL.CRM_DATE = DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE
            AND DAH.AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
            AND DAH.FORACID IS NOT NULL
            AND SUBSTRING(DAH.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
    LEFT JOIN eds.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING PROD
        ON DAH.GAM_SCHM_CODE = PROD.PRODUCT_TYPE
        AND DAH.GAM_BANK_ID = PROD.BANK_CODE
        AND DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN PROD.SCD_START_DATE AND PROD.SCD_END_DATE
where  DAH.FORACID	 like '%\%' or DAH.FORACID	like '%"%'  or DAH.FORACID	 like '%test%'
